none: PAS NLM-958C3A: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust probably diademed cuirassed right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this worn coin. Diameter: 16.0mm, Weight: 1.79gms, die axis: 12
